stories.title: Fiona the hippo dies after ingesting knitted hat at Cincinnati zoo
summary: Zoo staff tried a colonoscopy, vibration plate and other procedures to aid the hippo in passing the hat to no availFiona the hippo, one of America’s most famous zoo animals, has died after efforts to remove a knitted hat that she swallowed after it fell into her enclosure proved unsuccessful.With surgery too risky for a full-grown hippos like Fiona, who weighed in the region of 2,500lb (1,113kg), veterinarians tried alternative method of getting the hat to pass through her system.

stories.title: Guardian Australia takes home two Walkley awards for excellence in journalism
summary: Stories revealing Pauline Hanson’s US trip with Gina Rinehart and the systemic betrayal of Kardell Lomas before her death recognisedGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastGuardian Australia journalists have won two Walkley awards, one for a story about the systemic betrayal of a woman who was killed by her partner, and another for an exclusive story that revealed Pauline Hanson had travelled to the US with mining billionaire Gina Rinehart.Investigative reporter Sarah Martin won the award for print/text news report for her exclusive story that revealed the One Nation leader and her chief of staff, James Ashby, travelled with Rinehart on the mining magnate’s Gulfstream 700 on 27 October last year.

stories.title: Suspects charged in brazen train heist ring that netted $22m in cargo from major retailers
summary: More than a dozen people allegedly targeted trains carrying Nike sneakers, Crocs footwear and other goodsMore than a dozen people were charged Thursday with allegedly orchestrating a massive train heist operation to steal more than $22m in cargo – from popular shoes to power tools – from major retailers.A federal indictment unsealed on Thursday paints a picture of an organized group that targeted more than three dozen trains carrying Nike sneakers, Crocs footwear, power tools and other consumer goods that were imported into the United States through Los Angeles and Long Beach, which are home to the busiest ports in the country.

stories.title: Senate Republicans rejects war powers bill to halt fighting in Iran
summary: Measure fails 48-51 with GOP members again defending war that played a role in costing them midterm electionsThe Senate on Thursday rejected a war powers resolution aimed at forcing Donald Trump to halt fighting with Iran, with Republicans once again defending a conflict that played a major role in their sweeping midterm election losses.The House of Representatives had approved the resolution in September, and it was the first to be voted on by either chamber since the 3 November vote in which the GOP lost control of both chambers of Congress beginning next year.
